deployment_rule: A Kabuby Pages production deployment is not certified until every applicable already-certified owner surface has a production smoke result. Source hashes and local tests are necessary but never sufficient.

required: one authenticated Kabuby shell and one owner session
native Scout functional runtime renders without its legacy global shell or login screen
existing seven local records remain visible when present through the unmodified Scout renderer
product images, pricing metadata, detail, edit, category, inventory, and dispatch flows remain owned by the existing runtime
legacy compatibility route remains available for the Chrome extension and retains its independent authentication boundary when opened directly
Chrome extension handoff contracts remain unchanged
extension import stays in the authenticated owner shell and is handed to the same-origin native module host

failure_policy: Any failed applicable production smoke result blocks certification and requires diagnosis before unrelated UI expansion.
data_safety: The gate never initializes, migrates, deletes, or writes Scout browser storage.
scout_owner_data_path_verification: RUNTIME_AVAILABLE and OWNER_DATA_PATH_VERIFIED are separate results. OWNER_DATA_PATH_VERIFIED requires the owner browser profile, the same origin used by the extension and legacy runtime, and a production visual confirmation; it is not a seeded, synthetic, alternate-origin, or automated-browser localStorage result.
